title: Proposal Submission Deadline
description: The Research Proposal is the main research submission. It must be a maximum of 2 pages excluding cover page, title, citations, and references. Information on how to write a proposal and what to include will be provided in the bootcamps and further communication.
rules: Maximum 2 pages excluding cover page, title, citations and references.
Follow the official proposal formatting guidelines.

title: Video Pitch Submission Deadline
description: The top 100 Finalists must submit a 2.5-5 minute-long video submission. The Video Pitch should state the proposal's research question or objective and introduce the research process and potential future research avenues.
rules: Include your research question or objective.
Review the assessment guidelines before submission.
